name: Broken Tears

meta.previous: Assault on the Kolkar, Magram Alliance

summary: Warug says the Gelkis foolishly believe the centaur mother, Theradras, protects them. He sends you into the cave in their village to destroy the crystals they hoard there, the tears of Theradras, and bring him three of the broken pieces.

sections.title: Crystals in the Cave
sections.body: Warug scorns the Gelkis for trusting Theradras, mother of the centaur, to protect them. To him no one protects the centaur, and the Magram, being the strongest, need no protection. He sends you to the cave in the Gelkis village, where they keep a hoard of crystals called the tears of Theradras. Smash them and bring Warug three broken pieces. He will only trust you with this if you are no enemy of the Magram.

sections.title: Warug's Boast
sections.body: Warug is delighted: with the tears broken, the Gelkis will see that Theradras cannot help them, and no tears of hers will fall when the Magram crush them. He declares the Magram will rule, and calls you wise to side with the strongest.

faq.answer: A Magram centaur in Magram Village in Desolace. He asks you to destroy the tears of Theradras in the Gelkis cave.

faq.q: What are the tears of Theradras?
faq.answer: Crystals the Gelkis hoard in a cave in their village.

faq.q: Why does Warug want the tears destroyed?
faq.answer: The Gelkis think the centaur mother, Theradras, protects them. Warug calls them stupid, says the Magram need no protection, and wants to show the Gelkis they are wrong.
In the cave in the Gelkis village. Warug wants three broken pieces brought back to him.
